title: Warmly Roasted French Almond Skewers
description: A delicious and crowd-pleasing dish from Brittany, featuring marzipan and shio-koji cure, perfect for a paleo-friendly snack. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together sliced almonds, marzipan, shio-koji, coconut sugar, egg, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined.
Thread the almond mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the coconut oil onto the skewers, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the warmly roasted French almond skewers hot and enjoy.
